prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for an original cozy pixel-art cooking game. Crisp low-resolution hand-pixelled RPG artwork, warm dark 1-pixel outlines, three-tone pixel clusters, cream ceramic and teal enamel utensils, wooden surfaces only when specified. Top-down 3/4 food illustration, NOT photorealistic, no soft blur. REAL ALPHA TRANSPARENT background. Exact regular 4 columns x 4 rows with sixteen equal cells, generous transparent margin within EVERY cell. No grid lines, no text, no letters, no interface, no watermark, no people. Each row is FOUR successive states of the SAME subject in the SAME pose and scale, left to right. Four distinct subjects in four rows. Make the intermediate transformation and the clean final state obvious. Objects must not touch neighbouring cells. Row 1: a whole silver fish lying horizontally with tail LEFT and head RIGHT on NO board: (1) covered with visible large silver scales, (2) rear third near tail scraped smooth, (3) two-thirds scraped smooth with some scales remaining near head, (4) fully descaled smooth fish. SAME outline, no blood or wounds, do not fillet or remove head. Row 2: (1) whole brown onion, (2) peeled white onion with loose skin beside, (3) onion cut into two halves, (4) diced white onion in a tidy pile. Row 3: (1) whole brown coconut, (2) split coconut halves showing white flesh, (3) white coconut flesh pieces, (4) mound of finely grated white coconut. Row 4: (1) bowl of dry black-eyed peas, (2) same bowl peas soaking in clear water, (3) same bowl loosened dark skins floating, (4) same bowl peeled cream peas drained, almost no dark skins.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original top-down 3/4 RPG WORLD PROP sprite atlas, exact 4 columns x 2 rows, EIGHT distinct props, each isolated centered fully contained in equal square cell with generous transparent margin. REAL ALPHA transparency. Hand-pixelled SNES-like cozy RPG style: crisp dark outlines, clear simple pixel clusters, ochre wood, deep green, cream, teal, warm brick. NO people, NO text, NO letters, NO grid, NO ground plane. Row1: (1) compact street cooking cart with cream-and-green striped canopy, visible pot with food and prep counter, two wheels and wood base; this replaces a domestic stove in an outdoor market. (2) front of a welcoming Afro-Brazilian neighbourhood restaurant: ochre plaster, teal open double doors, small cream blank sign, terracotta tiles and two simple planters. (3) front of a contemporary public university building: cream stone and warm brick, central open teal door, modest symmetrical wings, dark green blank sign, a few books visible in windows, no text or crests. (4) freestanding professional kitchen prep island: wood chopping board, sink edge, neatly placed pots and bowls, kitchen tools. Row2 is FOUR ANIMATION FRAMES of exactly the SAME public drinking fountain, identical location scale and outline: teal-and-cream pedestal with silver basin and curved water spout; frame (5) no water flowing; (6) clear blue arc of water just emerging from the spout into basin; (7) a longer bright blue arc with two droplets; (8) same long arc slightly displaced with small splashes in basin. Fountain has NO plant, no domestic cabinets, no kitchen furniture. Each whole object isolated transparent. Do not make photorealistic or vector.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original cozy PIXEL ART illustration for a cultural cooking challenge named only in game UI, NO text in image. Wide composition showing a clean wooden cooking worktop from overhead 3/4 RPG perspective. On worktop: a cream cutting board with a whole silver fish and a blunt fish scaler, bowls of chopped vegetables, black-eyed peas, green banana leaves, a small pan of golden fritters, a bowl of red-orange fish moqueca, a plate of white pap with chakalaka, a wooden spoon and a coconut half. Background is a tidy warmly lit green-and-ochre teaching kitchen with tiled wall, simple hanging cookware and sunlight from a side window. No characters, no logos, no text, no copied Cooking Mama art. Crisp pixel clusters, dark warm outlines, limited earthy palette and cream/teal ceramic, matching hand-pixelled RPG character art. Rich and inviting, readable at a small game card size.
